sections.text: Introduction

These procedure details the steps required to completely
check the proper operation and calibration of GSST12-S1 relay . it is
recommended this procedure be carried out every 6 month bases the first preliminary
steps to prepare for relay testing describes the activates required prior to
testing .

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Moustafa Osman ,tested and revised by eng.Ali Ghater , accepted by eng. Farag 
Abo Youseff :general manager, approved by eng. Gomaa Ghater: head sector of Kafr 
el Dawar Power Station, 
and certified by eng. Gaber Mohmed Frahat : WDEPC inspection and quality 
control general director and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions

items: The equipment isolation is required.
A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Personal safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety shoes, safety 
 helmet ... etc

sections.text: Testing Procedures

Isolate the secondary terminal of the
voltage transformer .

Connect
the voltage test set terminals to point (4 ) for phase R and neutral
voltage to point (5)

Connect the current terminals to point (1)
IN and (2) OUT for phase S.

Connect the timer test set to points (17,18)
.

Inject the line voltage 100V to the relay
.
Inject the phase current to the relay.

Increase the current gradually until the
relay operate .
Record time and current .

sections_ar.text: يوضح هذا الإجراء الخطوات اللازمة للتحقق الكامل من سلامة تشغيل ريلاي GSST12-S1 ومعايرته، ويُوصى بتنفيذ هذا الإجراء كل 6 أشهر، وتصف الخطوات التمهيدية الأولى للتحضير لاختبار الريلاي الأنشطة المطلوبة قبل الاختبار.

أعد المسودة الأولى م. Moustafa Osman، واختبرها وراجعها م. Ali Ghater، وقبلها م. Farag Abo Youseff: مدير عام، واعتمدها م. Gomaa Ghater: رئيس قطاع محطة كهرباء كفر الدوار، وصدّق عليها م. Gaber Mohmed Frahat: مدير عام التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة بشركة غرب الدلتا لإنتاج الكهرباء ومنسق نظام معلومات إجراءات الصيانة.
